newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Sept 23.

text.p: -- Ultramar and Diamond Shamrock said they agreed to merge into a new company, converting each Diamond Shamrock share into 1.02 shares of Ultramar.
Ultramar shares closed on Monday at 28-1/2. Diamond Shamrock closed at 30-1/4.
-- AT&T Corp Chairman Robert Allen has said he plans to step down early and has a short list of six candidates for the company's presidency, the Wall Street Journal said.
-- Mossimo Inc said it expects disappointing third quarter earnings of $0.14 to $0.16 a share, below year-ago earnings and analysts' estimates. Mossimo closed at 41.
-- Signature Resorts Inc said it agreed to buy AVCOM for $28.8 million of stock and the assumption of $22.6 million of AVCOM debt.
Signature closed at 20-1/4. Avcom closed at 3-7/8.
-- Optical Coating Laboratory Inc said its plan to purchase and merge with Optical Corp of America was called off by Optical Corp.
